text:
Mia: Heads-up — Echelon Fin sent an RFI and wants a capability matrix + security questionnaire answers + POC schedule. Need a packaged response with attachments (cap matrix, sample POC runbook, pricing sheet). Can we get a draft by Thu EOD?

Ravi: I can take the capability matrix and the POC runbook. Quick q: are they asking for VPC/private deployment or just dedicated? Their note mentions HSM and ‘on-prem options’.

Mia: They wrote: "VPC + HSM required for pilot, potential on-prem later." Also asked about SOC2 scope and encryption-at-rest details.

Leah: I’ll handle the security questionnaire sections (encryption, KMS/HSM, SOC2, pen tests, data residency). Draft answers below — feel free to copy.

Leah: ```
Q: Do you support customer-managed keys / HSM?
A: Yes. Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; for HSM-backed key storage we offer an enterprise HSM integration (FIPS 140-2/3 compatible) as part of the Private offering. Key lifecycle, rotation, and logs are available via audit exports.

Q: Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
A: Yes. Data in transit uses TLS 1.2+; at-rest encryption via AES-256 with customer-managed key options where required.
```

Leah: Note — pen test evidence and SOC2 report are on the secure drive. I’ll attach links.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-sec/echelon/soc2-report-latest.pdf

Ravi: For the capability matrix I’ll map features to rows: model types (base/chat/embeddings), hosting modes (hosted/dedicated/private), SLAs, encryption, HSM, VPC, audit logs, SSO, certs, and integrations. I’ll mark recommended defaults for Echelon (Dedicated w/Private control plane).

Tom: POC schedule suggestion (2-week pilot):
```
Week 0: Kickoff & network onboarding (VPC peering / firewall rules) — 2 days
Week 1: Baseline deploy + functional tests (sample prompts, smoke tests) — 3 days
Week 2: Scale tests, latency tuning, quality review, handoff — 5 days
Deliverables: runbook, perf report, cost estimate, go/no-go checklist.
Resources: 1 SE (Ravi), 1 SRE on call, Dedicated pool: 2x A100 equiv reserved for pilot.
```

Tom: Pricing note: can offer 50% pilot credits on Dedicated usage and a fixed POC flat fee for network/setup if they require Private onboarding.

Ana: Product constraints: Private+HSM onboarding is typically a 4–6 week project (security reviews + infra), not immediate. For the pilot we can do a VPC-enabled Dedicated trial (customer-managed keys via cloud KMS) and simulate HSM flow; if they need physical HSM-backed on-prem, that’s a later phase. Also: quantization/latency tradeoffs need to be called out in the matrix.

Ravi: Action items: I’ll build the cap-matrix xlsx and draft the POC runbook. Leah will populate security answers and attach SOC2/Pentest links. Tom will draft schedule + pricing. Ana — can you add the note about 4–6 week Private/HSM lead time to the RFI response?

Ana: Yep — I’ll add a short section under "Deployment timeline & assumptions".

Mia: Great — please drop the files into the Echelon folder and ping me when ready. Deadline Thu EOD internal review (I’ll forward to the buyer Fri morning).

deploy-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-sales/echelon/capability-matrix-draft-v1.xlsx

Ravi: Uploaded initial matrix and runbook draft to the drive, link: https://drive.redwood.com/echelon/rfi-drafts (editable). Please comment.

Leah: Uploaded security Qs draft and SOC2 link. Added a short appendix for HSM integration steps.

Tom: Uploaded POC schedule + pricing sheet to same drive. I included two pricing options (pilot-credit vs flat-fee setup).

Mia: Perfect — assigning owners: Matrix & runbook = Ravi, Security Qs = Leah, Schedule/Pricing = Tom, Timeline note = Ana. I’ll collate and send to legal for review Wed AM. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Ana: FYI — if legal requests more detail on KMS logs format I can pull an example export.

Ravi: Noted. I’ll add a short network onboarding checklist to the runbook (firewall + routing + test endpoints).

Mia: Last ask — can someone add an explicit fallback plan in the runbook (if private onboarding delayed)? Just a paragraph on using hosted fallback variants + traffic routing policy.

Tom: Adding a fallback blurb now.

Mia: Thanks — we should be good. I’ll post final once legal signs off.
